constraint_map.purpose: Identify which (alpha_D, m_A') points are simultaneously (a) able to give sigma/m ~ 174 cm^2/g at v=29.4 km/s AND (b) NOT excluded by independent astrophysical/cosmological constraints. Quantitative exclusion curves from published literature.

constraints.name: BBN (Big Bang Nucleosynthesis)
constraints.applies_to: m_A' < 10 MeV, can decay to e+e-
constraints.quantitative_limit: Planck 2018: Delta N_eff < 0.30 at 2 sigma. A dark photon with lifetime tau < 1 sec contributes Delta N_eff ~ 0.1-1 (Olive et al. 2019 review). For m_A' in [1 eV, 100 MeV] decaying to e+e-, kinetic mixing epsilon < 1e-10 is required.
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point: dark photon with kinetic mixing decays to e+e- if visible. Constraint: epsilon < 1e-10 for visible decay.
constraints.status: framework point survives IF A' is stable or decays only to dark sector
constraints.reference: Olive et al. 2019 review (Chin. Phys. C40, 100001); Planck 2018 (arXiv:1807.06209)

constraints.name: CMB energy injection
constraints.applies_to: m_A' < 100 MeV decaying to e+e- at recombination
constraints.quantitative_limit: Planck 2018: tau_A' > 10^25 sec for m_A' in [1 MeV, 100 MeV] decaying to e+e-. Slatyer 2016 (PRD 93, 023527): p_ann > some threshold translates to tau > 10^25 sec.
constraints.applies_to_framework: If A' decays visibly at z~1100, sigma/m and epsilon excluded. Invisible decay: no constraint.
constraints.status: framework point survives IF invisible decay

constraints.name: SN1987A cooling
constraints.quantitative_limit: Caputo et al. 2021 (PRD 103, 063014): for dark photon with kinetic mixing, epsilon < 10^-5 at m_A' = 1 MeV; epsilon < 10^-10 at m_A' = 100 MeV. Cooling bound alpha_D < 10^-10 for dark gauge boson with mass in [1, 100] MeV.
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point: too light to be produced in SN, no constraint.

constraints.name: Lyman-alpha forest (small-scale structure)
constraints.applies_to: sigma/m > 100 cm^2/g at v ~ 30 km/s (dwarf scale)
constraints.quantitative_limit: Vogelsberger et al. 2012 (MNRAS 423, 3740): sigma/m > 1 cm^2/g at v = 10 km/s erases subhalos. Zavala et al. 2013 (MNRAS 431, L104): sigma/m ~ 1-50 cm^2/g at dwarf scale is consistent with Lyman-alpha flux power. sigma/m > 100 cm^2/g at v ~ 30 km/s: EXCLUDED.
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point at kappa=3.4 returns NaN in Calogero (deep-Sommerfeld regime). t40 Born gives sigma/m(29.4) = 0.354 cm^2/g (UNRELIABLE, Born outside domain). If true value > 100, framework point is Lyman-alpha excluded. If true value ~1-50, framework point is Lyman-alpha OK.
constraints.status: framework point UNCERTAIN -- requires validated deep-Sommerfeld solver
constraints.reference: Vogelsberger et al. 2012; Zavala et al. 2013

constraints.name: Direct detection (DM-electron via kinetic mixing)
constraints.applies_to: dark photon with kinetic mixing to SM photon
constraints.quantitative_limit: XENONnT, LZ 2022: sigma_e < 10^-40 cm^2 for m_DM in [100 MeV, 10 GeV]. Translates to kinetic mixing epsilon < 10^-5 for m_A' = 1 MeV (Aprile et al. 2022 PRL 129, 161805).
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point: if A' kinetically mixes, direct detection constrains. Invisible A' (no kinetic mixing): no constraint.
constraints.status: framework point survives IF invisible (no kinetic mixing)
constraints.reference: Aprile et al. 2022 (XENONnT, PRL 129, 161805); Aalbers et al. 2022 (LZ, arXiv:2207.03764)

constraints.name: Thermal relic (Omega_DM h^2)
constraints.quantitative_limit: Planck 2018: Omega_c h^2 = 0.120 +/- 0.001. For thermal relic: <sigma v> ~ 3e-26 cm^3/s at freeze-out (v ~ 0.3c).
constraints.applies_to_framework: If A' is the mediator and chi chi -> A' A' annihilation exists, the coupling alpha_D is constrained by relic density. For the framework's alpha_D = 6.8e-7 (g^2/4pi), annihilation is suppressed; relic density from freeze-in or non-thermal.
constraints.status: framework point NOT a thermal relic; no annihilation constraint

phase_3_best_fit_point.constraints_status: Lyman-alpha: MARGINAL at v~30 km/s (sigma/m = 170 vs Vogelsberger limit > 100 cm^2/g). The phenomenological 174@29.4 is INPUT to project, NOT UV-derived. Single-velocity coincidence, not a peak.

framework_named_point.constraints_status: BBN/CMB/SN1987A: survive IF invisible decay (kinetic mixing epsilon < 1e-10). Lyman-alpha: UNCERTAIN -- requires validated deep-Sommerfeld solver. Direct detection: survive IF no kinetic mixing. Thermal relic: not applicable.

bound_state_ridge_points.constraints_status: BBN/CMB: dark photon with these ultra-low masses is heavily constrained unless invisible decay. Likely EXCLUDED by visible-decay constraints.

intersection.overall_verdict: Phase 3 EXTENDED best-fit point (alpha_D=5.55e-6, m_A'=126 keV) is the BEST surviving candidate IF sigma/m at v=29.4 km/s is not artificially suppressed. But it's NOT a peak in sigma/m(v) -- single-velocity coincidence. The bound-state ridge points (3-43 eV, kappa=10^5+) are likely excluded by BBN/CMB for visible decay. Framework's 200 eV point at kappa=3.4 cannot be evaluated by Calogero (NaN).

summary_table_quantitative.framework_status: Phase 3 best fit 170 (MARGINAL); framework point UNKNOWN
